description: This file defines a React functional component called GuardrailsPanel, which manages a list of guardrails including fetching, displaying, adding, deleting, and viewing detailed info. It also includes UI logic for tab navigation and modal dialogs for confirmation and forms.

methods.name: fetchGuardrails
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the list of guardrails via external API call, updating the component state.

methods.name: handleAddGuardrail
methods.description: Prepares the modal for adding a new guardrail.

methods.name: handleCloseModal
methods.description: Closes the add guardrail modal dialog.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes guardrails list upon successful addition or update.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Prepares the delete confirmation modal for a specific guardrail.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the guardrail via API call, handles UI updates and notifications.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Cancels the delete operation and closes the confirmation modal.
